description.value: Raging Elk is a long-running adventure hostel in downtown Fernie, BC, operated by outdoor enthusiasts Joe and Sadie Howse, offering dorm beds, private rooms, family rooms, and unique deluxe pod-style accommodation. Situated within walking distance of downtown with mountain biking and hiking trails right outside the door, it serves as a well-equipped base camp for cyclists exploring the Fernie area. The property includes an onsite bar (Kodiak Lounge), sauna, games room, and dedicated cycling infrastructure that goes well beyond typical hostel offerings.
